0.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_TRANSFORMHLW2023_000_000
0.description: Up to something? Me? Never! I am but a fun-loving imp, here to help my fellow revelers enjoy the Wake! And I can fashion you a <hex:021A020203>very<hex:021A020103> convincing guise for the masquerade. Ehehehe...
0.translation_description: Hai combinato qualcosa? Io? Mai! Sono solo un imp burlone, qui per aiutare gli altri festaioli a godersi la Veglia! E posso confezionarti un travestimento <hex:021A020203>davvero<hex:021A020103> convincente per la festa in maschera. Eheh...

1.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_TRANSFORMHLW2023_000_001
1.description: All I need is your memory of someone, someone who made a <hex:021A020203>strong<hex:021A020103> impression. Someone unforgettable, someone <hex:021A020203>powerful<hex:021A020103>. Yes, that's it...
1.translation_description: Mi basta che tu ricordi una persona che ti abbia colpito... qualcuno che ti abbia fatto una <hex:021A020203>forte<hex:021A020103> impressione. Qualcuno indimenticabile, qualcuno di <hex:021A020203>potente<hex:021A020103>. Sì, proprio così...

2.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_TRANSFORMHLW2023_000_002
2.description: All I need is for you to recall a journey, a journey unforgettable. Traverse your memories, and tell me what you see...
2.translation_description: Mi basta che tu ripensi a un viaggio, a un viaggio indimenticabile. Ripercorri i tuoi ricordi e dimmi cosa vedi...

4.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A1_000_001
4.description: A journey to forge this realm anew.
4.translation_description: Un viaggio per forgiare di nuovo questo reame.

5.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A1_000_002
5.description: A journey to end a conflict of one thousand years.
5.translation_description: Un viaggio per porre fine a un conflitto durato mille anni.

6.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_TRANSFORMHLW2023_000_003
6.description: Good, good. Now think of someone remarkable you encountered in that time, someone <hex:021A020203>powerful<hex:021A020103>. Yes, that's it...
6.translation_description: Bene, bene. Ora pensa a qualcuno di straordinario che hai incontrato durante quel viaggio, qualcuno di <hex:021A020203>potente<hex:021A020103>. Sì, proprio così...

8.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_000_001
8.description: A Padjali woman as gentle yet indomitable as nature itself.
8.translation_description: Una donna Padjal, gentile ma indomita quanto la natura stessa.

9.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_000_002
9.description: A stalwart Roegadyn woman of unshakable conviction.
9.translation_description: Una salda donna Roegadyn, dalla convinzione incrollabile.

10.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_000_003
10.description: A rugged Hyuran man unmatched in loyalty and valor.
10.translation_description: Un vigoroso uomo Hyur, senza pari per lealtà e valore.

11.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_000_004
11.description: A charming and compassionate Lalafellin lady of noble birth.
11.translation_description: Una gentildonna Lalafell affascinante e compassionevole, di nobili natali.

12.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_000_005
12.description: A courageous and clever Garlean man admired by many.
12.translation_description: Un garleano coraggioso e ingegnoso, ammirato da molti.

13.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_000_006
13.description: A wry and ambitious Garlean man who hates to be outdone.
13.translation_description: Un garleano sardonico e ambizioso, che non sopporta di essere secondo a nessuno.

14.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_000_007
14.description: An eccentric Miqo'te man crimson of both hair and eye.
14.translation_description: Un eccentrico Miqo'te, dai capelli e dagli occhi color cremisi.

15.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_100_008
15.description: A compassionate Hyuran woman who leads a “secret” organization.
15.translation_description: Una donna Hyur compassionevole, a capo di un'organizzazione «segreta».

16.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_100_009
16.description: A formidable Roegadyn man recognized for his tactical brilliance.
16.translation_description: Un formidabile Roegadyn, celebre per il suo acume tattico.

17.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_100_010
17.description: A stunning Miqo'te woman famed as a peerless songstress.
17.translation_description: Una splendida Miqo'te, rinomata come cantante senza pari.

18.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_100_011
18.description: A Hyuran gentleman with an irrepressibly inquisitive nature.
18.translation_description: Un gentiluomo Hyur dalla curiosità incontenibile.

19.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_100_012
19.description: A loyal Miqo'te woman who assists a gentleman inspector.
19.translation_description: Una fedele Miqo'te, assistente di un gentiluomo investigatore.

20.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_100_013
20.description: A Hyuran man who began life anew in a realm reborn.
20.translation_description: Un Hyur che ha iniziato una nuova vita in un reame rinato.

21.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_100_014
21.description: An eager Lalafellin woman who is the coinkeeper of a “secret” organization.
21.translation_description: Una donna Lalafell zelante, tesoriera di un'organizzazione «segreta».

22.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_100_015
22.description: A Hyuran man who is known as Eorzea's most fearsome goldsmith.
22.translation_description: Un Hyur noto come il più temibile orafo di Eorzea.

23.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_000_009
23.description: A blue-eyed Elezen man with a heart noble and true.
23.translation_description: Un Elezen dagli occhi azzurri, dal cuore nobile e sincero.

24.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_000_010
24.description: A tenacious half-Elezen woman who fights for what is just.
24.translation_description: Una tenace mezz'Elezen, che lotta per ciò che è giusto.

25.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_000_011
25.description: A robed Lalafellin woman of the intellectual persuasion.
25.translation_description: Una Lalafell in tunica, dalle spiccate inclinazioni intellettuali.

26.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_000_012
26.description: A proud Elezen man unmatched in the art of the lance.
26.translation_description: Un fiero Elezen, senza pari nell'arte della lancia.

27.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_000_013
27.description: A daring Hyuran man who lives free as a bird.
27.translation_description: Un audace Hyur, che vive libero come un uccello nei cieli.

28.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_000_014
28.description: An Elezen man of noble birth fond of gossip and hearsay.
28.translation_description: Un Elezen di nobili natali, ghiotto di pettegolezzi e dicerie.

29.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_A2_000_015
29.description: A Hyuran man who turned his gaze heavensward.
29.translation_description: Un Hyur che ha rivolto lo sguardo verso i cieli.

31.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_TRANSFORMHLW2023_000_004
31.description: Ehehehe... That will do nicely. Don't worry, this won't hurt much at all! Just close your eyes...
31.translation_description: Ehehe... Così andrà benissimo. Non preoccuparti, non farà quasi per niente male! Chiudi gli occhi...

32.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_SYSTEM_000_005
32.description: The transfiguration can be removed by using the “Unveil” action, or by canceling the “Transfiguration” status effect.
32.translation_description: Puoi rimuovere la Trasfigurazione con l'azione «Svela» oppure annullando l'effetto di status «Trasfigurazione».

33.name: TEXT_FESHLW2023TRANSFORM_00834_TRANSFORMHLW2023_000_010
33.description: Pay no mind to this little imp! I'm <hex:021A020203>very<hex:021A020103> busy during the Wake─I've no time for mundane mummers, no.
33.translation_description: Non badare a questo piccolo imp! Sono <hex:021A020203>molto<hex:021A020103> impegnato durante la Veglia─non ho tempo per saltimbanchi da strapazzo.
